QuestInfo.name: An Upset Puppet
QuestInfo.0: #p1404000# wept like a small child, once again. He seems to be out of information, but you just can't resist poking fun at him a little longer.
QuestInfo.1: For now, get some more #b#t4033124##k items from the #rGolems#k and calm #o9300500# down. It's the least you can do for all the fun he gave you.\r\n\r\n#i4033137# #t4033137# #b#c4033137# / 50#k
QuestInfo.2: #p1404000# said that the Black Mage was going to give him #m220000000# when Maple World fell to his rule. He's either delusional, or incredibly stupid.

0.0: M-my puppet's broken again and now Orchid's gonna kill me and I'm just hopeless! I'm done for! I'll talk to #p2154002# and leave the Black Wings forever!\r\n#L0##bYeah, okay, whatever you want.#l\n#k
0.1: This is all your fault! *Sniff sniff* I'm so sorry, Lady Orchid... I was loyal to the very end! Don't come to my house and break my kneeeees! I'll get stronger, I promise! \r\n#L0##bYou want to be stronger? What do you say I bring you more of those #t4033124# things you love so much?#l\n#k
0.2: Wh-what kind of sick fun do you get out of toying with my emotions?! I'm not gonna take sympathy from you! I don't even like #o5130101# Cores! I hate them! \r\n#L0##bLook, you're a stupid kid. We all know that. Just let me get your things and we'll forget all of this ever happened.#l\n#k
0.3: R-really?\r\n#L0##bOf course. You'll just owe me one down the line, won't you?#l\n#k
0.4: I-I guess so, but... \r\n#L0##bThink about it. If you tell Orchid you've failed her now, what's she going to do? Plus, she'll be losing a VERY important subordinate. You don't want her to suffer like that, do you?#l\n#k
0.5: N-no, I don't. A-and I don't really hate the cores. Could you bring me #b50 #t4033124##k items? I just want to be strong...

yes.0: I-I'm not falling for your stupid charms! This is all for Lady Orchid... just go hunt down those #rGolems#k!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Why won't you just let me be?

1.0: You really brought them! Please get out of here before you change your mind and break my puppets again!\r\n#L0##bI'll leave, but I have one more question for you, my dear friend #p1404000#. What will you do when the Black Mage returns?#l\n#k
1.1: Don't talk to me like we're lifelong pals! When my master returns, he'll crush you and all the other fools across Maple World that oppose him. True devotees like myself will be rewarded with unspeakable treasures! \r\n#L0##bAn interesting theory. What do you think you'll get?#l\n#k
1.2: I plan on asking his everlasting majesty for #m220000000#. I'll turn it into a kingdom of puppets, with me as its king!

yes.0: And I'll get the #rSeal Stone of Victoria Island back! I already know where it is!#k I-I mean, you didn't hear that!
